chapter_title_en: The Little Head on the Wall
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 90: The Little Head on the Wall – Folk Horror at Its Finest
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang meets a little girl on a wall who wants a snack—but her description of the Stove God will make your blood run cold. A masterclass in rule-based folk horror.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 90: The Little Head on the Wall
og_description: A giggling child, a broken rule, and a Stove God that crawls on its own guts. Li Huowang faces the kind of horror that feeds on your fear of the familiar.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 90 – The Little Head on the Wall
twitter_description: A little girl wants a snack. She also has no body. And the Stove God? He has eight eyes and five hands. Folk horror doesn’t get much tighter than this.
